purpose: Finite incremental connection cancellation fanout comparison candidate/base; not original official-version target evidence or release acceptance
topology: hosted ubuntu24.04; one process containing loopback TCP client and server; one worker; same two allowed logical CPUs selected on distinct guest-reported (socket,core)
affinity: smallest allowed online CPU, then smallest allowed online CPU on a different guest (socket,core); stop if mapping unavailable
isolationClaim: None; retain guest core/socket/SMT and cgroup observations; no physical-core isolation claim
quantile: nearest rank ceil(n*p), exact integer rational rank, no floating-point percentile rank
pairOrder: odd pair baseline then candidate; even pair candidate then baseline; four pairs/cell (two ABBA blocks); scenarios rotated by pair index
failurePolicy: retain every planned slot and all raw failures; no replacement, exclusion, retry, adaptive stop or claim from incomplete evidence
releaseBoundary: Incremental connection cancellation fanout candidate 279fdb2a versus correctness baseline3d76 only; neither encoded-page nor outbound-lease candidates nor official NuGet2.0.3. Both retain independent call cancellation sources and strict physical cleanup ownership. Four representative normal-completion stream cells; no original official-version target, full parity or release-acceptance claim.
interopBoundary: Both same-version3.0.0 endpoints and own Generator/API5; no endpoint or generated-assembly mixing.
aggregation: Per cell median of four paired candidate/baseline QPS and P99 ratios; additionally recorded process-wide (client + server + runtime) double CPU microseconds/operation and allocated bytes/operation paired absolute values, ratios and median ratios. CPU/allocation are descriptive, no new target thresholds; allocated bytes are not object counts; exact rational ratios represent the recorded decimal values, not independent raw CPU-tick or allocation-census reconstruction. No operation pooling, best round, cross-cell global pass or incomplete-input target observations.
coldPolicy: Eight strict-cleanup processes (both arms x four cells) and eight symmetric normal-validate processes must pass before timing. Each of32 fresh normal-measure processes repeats normal-only controls. No cancellation/failure/early-exit probe in timed processes.
evidencePolicy: Raw ticks, reports, traces, build logs and all failures stay runner-local; no artifact upload, commit, comment, raw log dump or evidence publication. Independent same-job offline validator emits bounded per-cell QPS/P99 ratios, CPU/allocation paired absolute metrics and ratios, and failure status only. Ephemeral samples cannot support downstream independent recomputation.

dependencyPolicy.buildClosure: Four identical private10.0.12 dependency DLLs copied to both prepared snapshots; these are build closure, not asserted runtime load origins.
dependencyPolicy.executionClosure: Exactly four pinned Microsoft dependency identities from private Microsoft.AspNetCore.App10.0.14, common to both arms; all product and fixture assemblies remain own-arm only.
dependencyPolicy.remainingFrameworkClosure: Every other loaded non-dynamic assembly must match canonical path and SHA256 derived independently from the two fixed SHA512-verified private runtime14 archives; unknown, inserted or symlinked DLLs rejected. Collection and hashing occur outside all timing windows.

targetInterpretation: QPS1.10/P99.80 markers apply only to incremental candidate/baseline ratios; reaching them cannot establish the original goal versus officialNuGet2.0.3.

ordinaryUnitGate.requirement: Before any TCP process, build exact remote candidate, freshly discover every UID, execute the complete ordinary corpus exactly once under runtime14, and validate exact result UID equality with zero skips/failures/cancellations/timeouts/flaky passes. Preserve every output locally. No full ordinary test execution is implied by local UID discovery.
ordinaryUnitGate.scope: Only the five source-reviewed Explicit worker UIDs are excluded; ordinary TCP/UDS functional tests remain included.
ordinaryUnitGate.record: Both TCP driver and independent validator require unit-gate.json with this tool revision, frozen UID digests, actual runtime14 and both allocation-child runtime14 witnesses.
ordinaryUnitGate.diagnostics: Normal CI failure counts, public test names and bounded sanitized assertion summaries are permitted. Raw reports, test output streams, full traces and performance ticks remain local; every result validation layer has a distinct reason.
ordinaryUnitGate.temporaryDirectory: Short unique system-temp directory with a checked UTF8 pathname budget for unchanged ordinary UDS fixtures; never nest TMPDIR under diagnostic root; retain failures and local linkage.
